references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 0
references.quote: The following costs and fees may be charged in the Municipal Court:

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 1
references.quote: (a) Mandatory Costs. Except as provided in subsection (e) of this section, upon a finding of guilty, a plea of guilty, a plea of no contest, forfeiture of bond, or diversion, the court shall assess the following court costs:

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 2

references.quote: Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training Fund

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 74
references.quote: (b) Additional Costs. In addition, defendants may be assessed the following costs:

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 75
references.quote: (1) Warrant Fees. For each warrant issued, unless waived for good cause by the judge, a fee of $25.00 shall be assessed.

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 76
references.quote: (2) Incarceration Expenses. Unless waived for good cause by the judge, a fee for incarceration expenses shall be assessed against a defendant in each case in which said defendant is incarcerated pursuant to an order of the Municipal Court judge. The incarceration fee referenced in this subsection shall be determined by multiplying the then current daily rate of incarceration charged to the City of Topeka by Shawnee County Department of Corrections by the number of days actually served by the defendant.

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 77
references.quote: (3) Court-Appointed Attorneys. If the defendant is convicted and, unless waived or reduced for good cause by the judge, court-appointed attorney fees shall be assessed by the court against a defendant in each case in which a Municipal Court judge appoints counsel for said defendant.

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 78
references.quote: (4) Mileage. Mileage, subpoena and witness costs for defense witnesses shall be as set forth in TMC 2.40.450 .

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 79
references.quote: (5) Probation Fee. A probation fee as set forth in TMC 2.40.610 .

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 80
references.quote: (6) Miscellaneous Fees and Costs. If the defendant is convicted, additional costs and fees may be assessed by the Municipal Court for service of process, transcripts and depositions, commission on collections and credit/debit card transactions.

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 81
references.quote: (c) Except as provided herein, the judge or clerk of the Municipal Court shall remit at least monthly the appropriate assessments received pursuant to this section as required by State law, Kansas Supreme Court rule or City of Topeka policy or ordinance.

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 82
references.quote: (d) For the purpose of determining the amounts to be assessed according to this section, if more than one complaint is filed against an individual arising out of the same incident, all such complaints shall be considered as one case.

references.label: TMC 2.40.010 block 83
references.quote: (e) A person charged with a violation of the International Property Maintenance Code, adopted pursuant to TMC 8.60.010 , shall pay court costs identified in subsections (a) and (b) of this section unless found not guilty. However, upon a finding by the court that payment of court costs will impose manifest hardship on the accused person or the person’s immediate family, the court may waive payment of all or part of the amount due. (Ord. 20384 § 1, 11-1-22. Formerly 2.110.010.)
